title: Sensor-fusion trail v1 (the `trail` field of POST /submissions)
description: Recorded by client/src/lib/sensorFusion/tripRecorder.js, validated by backend/fusion/trail.py. Every field is optional; a malformed trail becomes the flag trail_invalid, never an error. Times are epoch milliseconds corrected to the SERVER's clock by the offset measured when the visit was opened.

time_origin.description: performance.timeOrigin (server-corrected); lets the server turn the raw 3 s sample's timestamps into epoch time for the cross-check

speed.description: m/s as reported by the device

acc_rms.description: m/s^2, gravity removed; null = no accelerometer data (never 0)

cad_hz.description: walking rhythm; null when the sensor rate is below 20 Hz or the signal is flat

motion.description: null_events = the browser fired devicemotion with every field null (a desktop): no sensor, NOT 'still'

x-radio-note: The separate `radio` field ({wifi:[{bssid_h, rssi}], cell:[{mcc,mnc,tac,cid,rssi}]}) is for a native app only; identifiers must already be hashed. A web page cannot read them.
